reviews.text:
Pretty but darker than I expected?
I got the Goldenrain Tree Library, and um. It's so pretty but, all shades look much darker on the skin than in the pan. Perhaps one of the weirdest formulas I've encountered so far? Can't believe nobody touched on that so far. 
ALSO, the two balm shades, I was very excited for them but... They lack pigmentation. I've tried using them on my lips, cheeks and eyes. OK for all purposes but show little to no pigmentation. Also I'm very fair but the shades barely show up on me. So um. Yea. Feels like two siliconey concealer shades that don't work very well. 
STILL. I get such beautiful eyeshadow looks from this palette, so I'm rating it highly. Keep in mind I have light bright shadows I add on top.
reviews.zh:
好靚，但顏色比我想像中深？
我買咗 Goldenrain Tree Library，嗯。好靚，但係所有色號塗喺皮膚上都比喺盤入面深好多。可能係我試過最奇怪嘅配方之一？唔敢相信到而家都冇人提過呢點。
另外，兩個 balm 色，我好期待，但……發色唔夠。我試過用喺唇、面頰同眼睛，用途都冇問題，但幾乎冇發色。而且我好白皙，但呢啲色喺我身上幾乎睇唔到。所以，嗯。好似兩個矽膠感嘅遮瑕膏色，效果唔太好。
不過，用呢盤調色盤都可以化出好靚嘅眼妝，所以我俾咗高分。要留意，我會喺上面加淺色亮面眼影。

reviews.text:
this eye shadow pallete is THE GOATTT. long lasting & great color payoff and mostly, the muted tone colors suit perfectly for my asian doe eyes (˶ˆᗜˆ˵) 

eye-makeup tip! how i apply these shadow is

1. i apply ALMOND POWDER color for the largest portion of my eyes.
2. i slightly put MAUVE INTENSE color when i want to add a bit more pink tone.
3. i use DUSTY HAZEL color near the double eyelid line
4. draw eyeliner or use ABOUT TAUPE color as an eyeliner.
5. slightly put CAFFEINE PLEASURE color on my under eye triangle area.

hope this helped and plz like my comment ˙🍓 ̟ !!
reviews.zh:
呢款眼影盤係 THE GOATTT！持久力好，發色好，而且大部分啞色調都好啱我嘅亞洲鹿眼（asian doe eyes）。

眼妝小貼士！我用呢啲眼影嘅方法係：

1. 用 ALMOND POWDER 色塗喺眼皮最大嘅一大片位置。
2. 想加少少粉紅色調嗰陣，輕輕加 MAUVE INTENSE 色。
3. 用 DUSTY HAZEL 色塗近雙眼皮線。
4. 用眼線筆畫，或者用 ABOUT TAUPE 色做眼線。
5. 喺眼尾下方嘅三角位輕輕加 CAFFEINE PLEASURE 色。

希望幫到你，麻煩讚我留言 ˙🍓 ̟ !!

reviews.text: Colors are super pretty and go on the eye really bright, but the shimmers and glitters are super hard to blend.
reviews.zh: 顏色好靚，上眼好鮮艷，不過珠光同亮片真係好難暈開。

reviews.text: I'm a makeup beginner. This is my first palette and I don't need a second one. I am very glad I chose this palette because it contains neutral colors and peach. I thought that the neutral color would suit me, but the peach color suits me better. I also obsessed "mute shade", this shimmer is so delicate and comfortable for everyday use. Other glitters fell-off too easily, so maybe I need a base for them.
reviews.zh: 我係化妝新手。呢個係我第一個眼影盤，而且我唔需要第二個。我好慶幸揀咗呢個盤，因為佢有中性色同蜜桃色。我本來以為中性色最啱我，但係蜜桃色其實更襯我。我都迷上咗「mute shade」，呢款閃粉好細緻，日常用好舒服。其他閃粉好易脫落，所以可能要先搽個底。

reviews.text:
The Clio Pro Eye Palette Air in Shade 02 Rose Connect is a captivating addition to the world of eyeshadows, offering a harmonious blend of colors that seamlessly transition from day to night. With its innovative formula and carefully curated shades, this palette has become a staple for makeup enthusiasts seeking versatility and quality.

The first notable aspect of the palette is its packaging. Housed in a sleek, compact case, the Rose Connect palette exudes a sense of sophistication. The exterior features a soft matte finish, adorned with the signature Clio logo, creating an aesthetic that is both modern and timeless. The compact size makes it travel-friendly, allowing users to carry their favorite eyeshadow palette wherever they go.

Upon opening the palette, the array of colors immediately captures attention. The Rose Connect palette boasts a range of hues inspired by romantic rose tones, carefully selected to complement various skin tones.
reviews.zh:
Clio Pro Eye Palette Air 02 Rose Connect 係眼影世界入面一個令人著迷嘅新成員，色彩和諧融合，由日間到夜間都可以無縫過渡。憑住創新嘅配方同精心挑選嘅色號，呢個眼影盤已經成為追求多功能同優質嘅化妝愛好者嘅必備之選。

呢個眼影盤最值得一提嘅係包裝。佢收納喺一個時尚細巧嘅盒子入面，Rose Connect 眼影盤散發出一份優雅感。外殼採用柔和嘅啞光處理，配上 Clio 嘅招牌標誌，營造出又時尚又經典嘅觀感。體積細小，方便攜帶，用家可以隨時帶住心愛嘅眼影盤出門。

打開眼影盤，一排色彩即刻吸引目光。Rose Connect 眼影盤包含一系列靈感來自浪漫玫瑰色調嘅色彩，經過精心挑選，可以配合唔同膚色。

reviews.text:
진짜 좋아요. 브러쉬에 조금만 묻혀도 발림 짱짱이구 근데 또 블렌딩도 자연스럽게 잘 되구요. 팔레트 안에 들어있는 브러쉬도 엄청 부드럽고 블렌딩 잘 됨. 색감은 생각보다 더 내추럴한 색이지만 데일리/자연스러운 메이컵용으로 쓰기 너무 좋구 안에 글리터도 세가지 다 입자가 달라서 골고루 다 사용 할 수 있어서 버리는 것 없어서 너무 좋아요

Really great product. Even if you apply just a little bit on the brush, the color is strong enough, yet it also blends in so smoothly and naturally. The brush inside the palette is very soft and does blending very well. The colors are more on the natural shade than I expected, but it’s fit for daily/natural makeups. And the three glitters are all different sizes/types, so you can use all of them together without having repeats and using just one over the other.
reviews.zh:
真係好好。只要喺刷頭少少沾一下都已經好易推開，而且混色都好自然。盒入面附送嘅刷子都好軟，混色好好。色感比想像中更加自然，但好適合日常／自然妝容用。盒入面嘅三款閃粉粒度都唔同，所以可以全部平均咁用，冇浪費，好好。

真係好好嘅產品。就算刷頭只沾一小點都已經發色足夠，而且混色都好順滑自然。盒入面嘅刷子好軟，混色效果好好。色彩比我想像中更偏自然色，但適合日常同自然妝容用。而且三款閃粉嘅粒度／類型都唔同，所以可以全部一齊用，唔會重複，亦唔會只係用其中一款覆蓋另一款。

reviews.text:
The colours are very nice neutrals, here's a comparison picture with 3ce's smoother for reference. The brush is also very soft and is an upgrade to their old ones.

But despite the shadows being really smooth and blendable, my problem is that they don't seem to layer well– they slide off each other and end up looking muddy. Because of this, the pigmentation feels deceptively bad. Use your darker shades first.
I also struggled with glitter fallout over time so beware.
reviews.zh:
呢啲顏色係好靚嘅中性色，我附上一張同 3ce smoother 嘅比較圖作參考。刷子都好軟，比佢哋舊款升級咗。

不過，雖然眼影好滑、好易推開，但我嘅問題係佢哋好似唔易疊色——會互相推走，最後變到髒兮兮。因此發色會令人感覺好差，但有誤導性。要先用深色。
我用咗一段時間，閃粉散落都係一個問題，要留意。

reviews.text: Please, immediately think about whether the shades of your skin will suit. If you have a pink undertone, then this palette will be quite difficult to use. But, it is no less beautiful, perfectly matched shades, excellent pigmentation and incomparable glitter. If you still use a primer for them, then you can go through a week without updating your makeup (this is said in jest, remember that every day we must carefully take care of our skin)
reviews.zh: 請先諗清楚呢啲顏色啱唔啱你嘅膚色。如果你係粉紅色調嘅皮膚，呢個眼影盤會比較難用。不過，佢一樣好靚，色號配搭得好完美，發色一流，閃粉無可比擬。如果你仲會用 primer 打底，可能一個禮拜都唔使重新補妝（呢句係開玩笑嘅，緊要記住每日都要好好照顧皮膚）。
